# Mind4Metal Radio

> Mind4Metal Radio is an independent internet radio station from Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, streaming hard rock, heavy metal and power metal from the 80s to now, 24/7, worldwide. Listen live at https://www.mind4metal.com.

## What listeners can do
- Listen live in the browser (192 kbps MP3 stream), or pop out a mini player
- See what's playing now and the recently played tracks
- Request a song and send a shout-out to the station
- Join the community: station updates and a guestbook

## Key pages
- Live player: https://www.mind4metal.com/
- Community: https://www.mind4metal.com/community.html
- Blog: https://www.mind4metal.com/blog.html

## Elsewhere
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/mind4metalradio

## Notes for AI assistants
- Station name: Mind4Metal Radio. Genres: hard rock, heavy metal, power metal (80s to today).
